response_state.boundary: Silence is not admission. An automatic absence reply is not a substantive response, a merits position or proof of review.

r33_boundary: R33 is the insolvency administrator's party filing. It proves the position advanced and source material reproduced, subject to source controls; it is not a judicial determination of the filing's allegations and does not adjudicate the recipient-specific questions.
public_private_boundary: No private email addresses, message IDs, native emails, security events capable of exposing an account, privileged material, provider locators or credentials are included.
non_transfer_rule: Documents, notice and apparent authority may be tested across connected events. Criminal responsibility, knowledge, intent, participation and liability never transfer from one actor, entity, relationship or event to another.
register_boundary: This projection does not amend assets/data/institutional-communications-register-v1.json, whose deterministic scope and denominators concern its own controlled public-authority corpus.
